name: kronos_small_zero_shot
training_cutoff: pretrained by its authors (Kronos, AAAI 2026); never trained on this data
description: Kronos small (24.7M parameters, MIT) zero shot: reads the trailing 400 daily OHLCV bars of each stock and generates the next bar; the signal is the predicted close over the last close minus one, averaged over three samples (T=1.0, top_p=0.9). Weights NeoQuasar/Kronos-small and NeoQuasar/Kronos-Tokenizer-base from Hugging Face; script in contestants/kronos_zero_shot.py.
